description: Look up a country or location in the Foreign Agents Register by a substring of the country string exactly as DOJ prints it (as entered by registrants and never re-mapped, for example "KOREA, SOUTH"), optionally for one year (2024 or 2025; both when omitted). Returns up to 3 matching countries, each with the money agents reported receiving for its principals for the registrants' six-month periods ending in that year, as DOJ's reports print it, with DOJ's posting date; entries, entries with an amount, "None Reported" entries (never zero) and entries with no Finances line; registrants with money; the withheld part of the country total, as counts and money only; active principal rows and registrants from DOJ's bulk files; the Nature of Services of the published entries; and the largest published registrants and principals with their amounts. Every answer carries DOJ's footnote that country or location is not reflective of U.S. foreign policy and does not imply a recognition of sovereignty. Country strings are DOJ's, as entered by registrants, and are not a statement of U.S. foreign policy. Registration under FARA is a legal disclosure, not a finding of wrongdoing; in the Justice Department's words, registration "does not indicate approval by the United States Government of the activities of registered agents". FARA receipts, LDA filing counts and PAC contributions are separate measures, shown side by side and never added. Individuals are withheld: counted only, never named.

country.description: Required case-insensitive substring of the country or location string as DOJ prints it (for example "KOREA, SOUTH"), at most 80 characters.

year.description: Optional year of the registrants' six-month periods, 2024 or 2025; both when omitted.

name: foreign_agents_country
title: Find FARA Records by Country
